evidence_items.locator: Executive Order 14409, section 5(b); frontier-model provisions in section 3
evidence_items.explanation: Section 3 establishes voluntary arrangements and does not authorize mandatory model preclearance. The quoted provision preserves applicable law, so this order alone cannot establish the absence of every other approval requirement in November.
